name: Room Service

surfaces.surface_type: main-window / Health Check dashboard (from marketing cover composite; app window is the evidence, #0B0B0B backdrop is brand)
failures: #9 dimmest tertiary metadata (category labels, unit sizes) ~2.5-3.5:1 on dark cards, below 4.5:1
#10 card/tile hairline borders ~1.1-1.3:1 vs canvas, well below 3:1 non-text floor
native#4 sidebar section header 'DEVELOPER' is tracked uppercase (native = sentence-case system semibold secondary)
native#3 sidebar selection is correct inset-rounded shape (~8pt) but neutral #242424 fill with white label, no accent tint
native#6 accent not bound to selection/focus; brand orange overloads the warning semantic hue

tokens.notes: content + sidebar share one graphite field
only ~1 lightness step above canvas; elevation via border not fill
inset rounded ~8pt, NEUTRAL not accent-tinted; label stays white
score ring, badges, CTA labels, 'Needs attention'; = system Orange (dark)
Action Needed, paired with x glyph
Warnings - SAME hue as brand accent (semantic overload)
per-category dots, correctly separate from accent
kit Medium tier; comfortable native density
real window frame; establishes 1.67x composite scale

tokens.value: custom: PRO+version badge leading, borderless SF-Symbol capsule cluster trailing (Cmd-K palette, dark-mode, quick-actions, doc, terminal)

patterns.key_values: source-list, ~256pt-ish width, ~32pt rows, inset-rounded neutral selection (~8pt radius), count-badge pills (orange), tracked-uppercase 'DEVELOPER' section header (non-native), icon-dot + right-aligned size list, pinned Settings at bottom
custom top bar, not a native NSToolbar; leading version/PRO badge, trailing borderless-monochrome SF-Symbol group in a capsule, includes Cmd-K command-palette affordance
4-up equal stat tiles (status glyph in tinted square + big number + secondary label), flat #181818 fill, hairline border elevation, ~10-12pt radius
disclosure rows - warning chip + bold title + inline status badge + secondary category label + trailing chevron; 'Show N More' full-width ghost expander
hero health-score card: orange progress ring (59/score, ~60% arc) + context chips + large verdict title + two equal secondary buttons (Save Report / Refresh Check)

signature_moves: Borders-as-elevation, near-monochrome graphite: cards one lightness step above canvas, no shadow, no tonal ramp - the whole identity, and the main a11y liability
Single warm accent (#FF9300) as the sole chromatic event over a grayscale + glyph-paired-system-status field (restrained color strategy, accent <10% pixels)
Apple-Health-style score ring + 4-up severity triage tiles (Action Needed/Warnings/Review Notes/Healthy) transplanted onto a dev-cleanup utility
defects: UI Contrast (rubric #10) - hairline card/tile borders ~1.1-1.3:1, cards nearly merge into canvas; fix to kit Fills Dark #FFFFFF@8-10% or >=3:1
Sidebar authenticity - tracked-uppercase 'DEVELOPER' section header (native #1 sidebar tell); use sentence-case system semibold secondary
Selection missing accent tint - inset-rounded shape correct but neutral fill + white label instead of accent-tinted label
Accent/semantic overload (Von Restorff dilution) - brand orange identical to warning orange; focal pull of score ring diluted across warning badges
Contrast Dilution (rubric #9, soft) - faintest tertiary metadata ~2.5-3.5:1 below 4.5:1

aesthetic.direction: Neo-grotesque product (dark neutral ramp + one accent) per frontend-aesthetic-direction range map - but rotated warm: warm-orange accent instead of the usual electric/acid; depth is borders-only, elevation refused

psychology: Von Restorff - the one-different-thing (orange score ring) is undercut because orange is ALSO every warning badge; accent overload dilutes the focal event
Jakob's Law - familiar SaaS-dashboard layout (sidebar + score + stat tiles + findings list) means devs already know how to read it; conventional interface, innovative product
Miller/Cowan chunking - content chunks to ~4 stat tiles + grouped finding sections, within the ~5-chunk working-memory limit
Zeigarnik / Fogg self-monitoring - '59 / Needs attention' + open triage counts create legitimate fix-me pressure (self-monitoring is the app's job)
Serial-position - most-critical tile (Action Needed) placed first in the 4-up row; good ordering
Aesthetic-usability (with a limit) - polished flat surface buys first-contact trust, but sub-3:1 borders weaken Gestalt common-region so related cards nearly read as one
notes: SINGLE surface only, and it is extracted from a marketing COVER composite (app window on #0B0B0B backdrop) - no dedicated screenshots (meta.json shots[] empty). Treat the backdrop as brand, the window as design evidence. Composite renders the window at ~1.67x (not clean @2x) - traffic-light dot 20px=12pt, spacing 33.5px=20pt both agree; hence wide (estimated) ranges on type/space. LINEAGE is the key judgment call: 13pt body + genuine 12pt traffic lights + 32pt source-list rows + inset-rounded selection = native (SwiftUI) density/bones, so classified native/med and its native-honoring readings may feed canon; BUT it wears a heavy web/SaaS-dashboard skin (Cmd-K palette, tracked-uppercase header, card-grid, status-pill vocabulary, custom top bar, flat border-elevation) whose deviations are logged as tells/signatures, not canon. If a later real screenshot shows a WebView/Electron tell (pointer-hand cursor, 16px body, no real menu bar), downgrade to web-electron. No settings/empty-state/light-mode/onboarding surfaces seen. Icon (icon.png, not digested here per Workflow-A-only scope) is a glassy dark torus/ring 'O' form on near-black - a Liquid-Glass-flavored monogram; queue for Workflow B. Corpus impact: first member of a proposed 'graphite-dashboard' pro-tool cluster; no promotions possible from one app.
